text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SERVICE=redwood-canary-deploy severity=high. Metric: canary /v1/generate 5xx rate spiked from 0.2% -> 8.6% over last 3m. Autosuppress not applied due to low traffic fraction.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC292222-AUTO fired for redwood-canary-deploy — responders: eng-oncall. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC292222-AUTO
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at commit abc1234 -> tag release/v1.12.7. Observability: rolling 10% traffic to canary across us-west-2.
marco: ack — picking this up, will triage. Can someone grab logs from the canary pods? @deploy-bot can you paste pod list?
deploy-bot: pods: r-canary-1 (node-g4-12), r-canary-2 (node-g4-08), r-canary-3 (node-g4-05)
marco: grabbing logs — seeing repeated OOMKill in r-canary-2 and high allocation churn in r-canary-1. stacktrace shows tokenization worker stuck, GPU memory shadows rising before OOM.
jenny: @marco adding telemetry: cloud-metrics shows network egress spike correlated with big prompt sizes from a single client IP range. Could be an edge replay test.
linda: flagged — product noticed customers in beta group A reported degraded completions. Impact estimate: ~3% of requests, mostly long-context generation. Not seeing data exfil.
marco: mitigation plan: 1) scale canary replica count to 6 to spread load 2) throttle max input tokens to 1024 for canary 3) if errors persist, rollback canary to previous tag.
sam: customer comms: we should prepare a brief note if rollback happens. Linking support ticket TKT-5821.
marco: applying throttling, patch below:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  canary_max_tokens: "1024"
```
deploy-bot: config applied to canary configmap. Rolling configmap reload to pods.
marco: After throttle, 5xx dropped to ~5% but still elevated. r-canary-2 still showing OOMs. I'm going to cordon and evict r-canary-2 to avoid repeat.
deploy-bot: Evicting pod r-canary-2 -> new pod scheduled r-canary-4 on node-g4-11.
pagerduty: INC292222-AUTO escalated to ENG-L2 because initial ack not cleared in 5m.
marco: Escalation noted. Running memory snapshot on r-canary-1 and r-canary-4. Seeing large KV cache growth from repeated prefix caching for long-context prompts (likely RLHF eval pipeline).
jenny: Could be the new attention kernel change in v1.12.7 triggering memory mis-accounting for kvcache. Will check kernel selection logs.
marco: Kernel logs show quantized attention path chosen for 16-bit mixed config. Suspect regression on quant path for very long context. Given continuing OOMs, I recommend rollback to release/v1.12.6 for canary. Requesting rollback now.
linda: +1 from product — rollback is safest to minimize customer impact. Sam, prepare a short status for affected customers: we rolled canary back due to memory regression, no data loss, monitoring.
sam: on it. Draft: "We're rolling back a canary release after detecting higher error rates for long context requests. We're restoring the previous build; expect normal behavior within 10-20 minutes. No data lost."
marco: Initiating rollback: kubectl set image deployment/redwood-canary redwood=registry.redwood/release:v1.12.6 --record
deploy-bot: Rollback started at 2922222450, rollout status: 0/6 updated -> 3/6 -> 6/6.
marco: Rollback completed. Verifying metrics... p50/p95 token latency stable. 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.3% within 6m.
pagerduty: INC292222-AUTO acknowledged and resolved by marco at 2922222560.
marco: handing off to jenny for post-deploy verification and postmortem coordination. jenny, please own the postmortem and include kernel/quantization team.
jenny: taking handoff. I'll collect logs, kernel-selection traces, reproduce on staging with long prompts, and schedule postmortem doc. ETA initial report 2h.
linda: thanks team. Product follow-up: pause further canary rollouts for v1.12.x until root cause fixed and verified.
sam: customer note sent to TKT-5821 and affected beta customers. Received one confirmation: "Thanks for the quick rollback."
marco: quick summary for the incident record: cause=regression in quant attention path for long contexts in v1.12.7; impact=~3% requests, increased 5xx, affected beta customers; mitigation=throttle + pod eviction then rollback to v1.12.6; status=resolved, postmortem assigned to jenny.
jenny: adding tasks to incident board and pinging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime for triage. Will include reproducer steps and perf diffs.
marco: closing thread, reached baseline and monitoring. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
